paper.mapping: Three Bugeon evaluation settings; 2/5/11 label families; subject folds and development exclusions.

sources.semantics: Train-only scaling; weighted or resampled logistic readout; pooled CV macro F1; earliest tied checkpoint; pooled selected test predictions.
Single validation split refits on train union val before selected test scoring.
Checkpoint epoch ordering and identical unit ordering; label-map and split objects. Strict ID coverage is prospective and replaces permissive omission.
Session-local unit ID and EI/subclass derivation. neuron.UniqueID ingestion is commented out; no repeated-cell proof.
Five SB028 sessions excluded from pretraining; four non-development sessions in evaluation.
Four development sessions excluded from evaluation, not globally forbidden in training.
All source sessions available in transductive representation training.
Online evaluator inspected only to distinguish its subclass exclusions from authoritative offline split labels; no online filtering transplanted.

retrieval.method: Connected web source text/PDF retrieval; raw HTTPS source requests failed SSL EOF; OpenReview browser challenge, official NeurIPS paper used.
retrieval.evidence_hash_interpretation: External SHA256s identify browser-rendered retrieval receipts, not original upstream file bytes. Immutable commit and source paths pin code provenance.

prospective_policies: Owner-controlled JSON projection instead of unsafe deserialization or candidate-controlled labels.
Require exact complete labeled-unit identities, explicit source exclusions and source-label encoding bijection.
Require distinct source-session and representation exposure manifests; do not require each label family to occur in every source session.
Validate all three evaluation topologies, epoch order and finite embedding dimensions.
Delay test fitting until selection; compute no scores for unselected test checkpoints.
Fail on nonconvergence or missing resampling dependency; no silent fallback.
Report subject-level paired diagnostics without statistical improvement inference.

implemented: Session/label count join and identity derivation
Source linear readout on supplied embeddings
CV checkpoint selection and pooled classification metrics
not_implemented_or_not_qualified: Authentic data acquisition and split identity validation
Native NuCLR or ablation representation fitting
